{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing currency symbols and handling commas
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace('$', '', regex=False)
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for completed orders from LOYAL customers
loyal_completed = sales_df[(sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales_df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Validate the filter: check number of rows and sample of data
print(f'Number of completed LOYAL orders: {len(loyal_completed)}')
print(f'Sample of revenues: {loyal_completed["revenue"].sample(5).values}')"}
